purpose: Four foliage-card variants, no paid Meshy jobs
initial: Create a production game foliage color texture atlas, exactly 1024x1024 RGBA with a genuinely transparent background. Four separate vertical willow sprig panels arranged in four equal 256-pixel-wide columns, full height with 24px clear padding around the outer edge and 16px transparent gutters on column boundaries. Each panel contains one long slender hanging willow branch with several fine secondary stems and many narrow lanceolate leaves drooping downward. Top attachment at top center of each column, tip at bottom center; leaves fully inside their column. Panel 1 dense silvery sage-green; panel 2 medium density rich natural willow green; panel 3 airy mint-green with warm olive accents; panel 4 slightly curved dense olive-green. These are foliage-card sprites for a romantic dark fairytale game, stylized realism, softly hand-painted fine leaf veins and elegant botanical shapes, not cartoon blobs. Preserve small natural gaps between leaves and asymmetrical silhouette. Use muted natural green colors, subtle baked leaf form shading, no neon, no glow, no broad ambient shadows. No surrounding tree, trunk, pot, ground, horizon, text, labels, grids, checkerboard or border. Every leaf interior opaque; clean antialiased alpha around individual leaf edges, completely transparent empty space. The stems must be thin woody twigs, not broad geometric triangles. Flat orthographic atlas, not a perspective scene.
cleanup: Edit this foliage atlas ONLY to clean its transparency and arrange it for use as a game texture. Preserve the four willow sprigs and their natural sage, olive and willow green leaf colors and leaf shape. Completely remove ALL fluorescent green and fluorescent yellow speckles, patches, fringe and background noise surrounding and between the leaves. The empty areas must have clean zero alpha, not any solid green, yellow, white, black or gray pixels. Real RGBA transparency. Keep opaque leaf interiors and a narrow smooth antialiased silhouette only. Do not create halos. Exactly four non-overlapping equal-width vertical columns in a square 1024x1024 atlas; each sprig must fit within its own 256-pixel column with at least 12px fully transparent margins on both sides, plus 16px at image top and bottom. No leaf may cross a column boundary. Flat diffuse colors, no baked cast shadows. No text, no visible grid, no background.
